description: Get one of the day's two GATE Daily subject sets: five original GATE CS questions on one subject, a deeper rep than the mixed daily set. For signed-in users (free); without a GATE Daily sign-in this asks the user to connect their account. Leave out subject to see the day's choice. Returns the questions without answers; submit with submit_answers and the subject.

date.description: A past day's date, YYYY-MM-DD (IST). Leave out for today's.

subject.description: Subject code of the set; leave out to list the day's sets.

name: get_subject_set
title: Get a subject set
